answered.sql: SELECT T2.critic_rating, T2.audience_rating FROM Role AS T1 JOIN FilmReviews AS T2 ON T1.film_id = T2.film_id JOIN Actor AS T3 ON T1.actor_id = T3.id WHERE T3.name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio'

candidates.meaning: Find the rating of the movies where Leonardo DiCaprio has a role.
candidates.sql: SELECT Film.title, FilmReviews.critic_rating FROM Film JOIN Role ON Film.id = Role.film_id JOIN FilmReviews ON Film.id = FilmReviews.film_id WHERE Role.actor_id = (SELECT id FROM Actor WHERE name = 'Leonardo DiCaprio')
